title: Credit and Collections Policy Excerpt: Patient Hardship Discount Program Pending-Application Hold
content:
**Pending applications and collections.** While a Patient Hardship Discount Program application is pending and the level provides a collections hold, the patient's balances are not transferred to collections, for up to the level's longest hold in calendar days.

| Application pending | Level provides a collections hold | Within the longest hold | Balances transferred to collections under this clause |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Not transferred |

**Reading the clause.**

- The hold covers the patient's balances.
- The hold lasts while the application is pending, and never beyond the level's longest hold, counted in calendar days.
- An application no longer pending — approved or denied — is outside the condition of this clause.

**Hypothetical example.** An application has been pending for some days, fewer than the level's longest hold, at a level that provides the hold. On that day the patient's balances are not transferred to collections.
